title: Nous Research confirms it hit $1.5B valuation, launches AI agents for business users
slides: What if AI agents could run your business?
They launched agents for business users—not just techies.
Now you can deploy AI agents without writing code.
Which task will you delegate first?
thread_text:
1. The $1.5B code-free bet

Nous Research just hit a $1.5B valuation. Their new agents are aimed at business users, not developers.

2. Built for non-techies

You can now deploy these agents without writing a single line of code. That removes the biggest barrier for most teams.

3. Agents that run the show

The pitch: these agents don't just answer questions. They can execute tasks and manage workflows on their own.

4. Your first delegation

What would you hand off first? A report, a scheduling mess, a research rabbit hole—pick one and see if it sticks.

5. Test it this week

Take a real task you did yesterday and try an agent on it. If you haven't done that yet, start there.
